account.networkCountSource: Walmart Inc. Form 10-K (FY ended Jan 31, 2025): Sam's Club U.S. operates 31 dedicated distribution facilities plus 14 dedicated eCommerce fulfillment centers. https://stock.walmart.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000104169-25-000021/wmt-20250131.htm
account.sampleRationale: The 10 audited DCs span owned cross-docks and dedicated 3PL sites across the South and Midwest, representative of the 45-facility US distribution and fulfillment network feeding ~600 clubs.

coverageNote.note: Sam's Club U.S. operates 45 dedicated freight facilities (31 distribution centers + 14 eCommerce fulfillment centers per Walmart's FY2025 10-K), several 3PL-operated by Saddle Creek / Prologis, feeding ~600 clubs. We audited 10 representative facilities.

account.dossierIntro: Sam's Club runs a lean distribution network separate from its Walmart parent, a mix of owned cross-docks and dedicated 3PL DCs (Saddle Creek, Prologis) feeding roughly 600 warehouse clubs. We mapped 10 of them across the South and Midwest, holding 1,083 dock doors and room for about 2,530 trailers. Eight of the ten sit behind a controlled truck gate and five run a staffed guard booth, but the control is uneven and two DCs sit open to the road. YardFlow gives Sam's Club one gate-to-dock view across owned and 3PL yards alike.
surprisingFindings: Eight of the 10 Sam's Club DCs gate the yard and five staff a booth, but Hattiesburg and Edwardsville sit wide open to the road with no checkpoint.
Several Sam's Club DCs are run by third parties: Saddle Creek in Lakeland, Hattiesburg, and Villa Rica, and a Prologis lease in Lithia Springs.
Only Searcy touches rail, with an intermodal container in the yard. The other nine DCs move everything in and out by truck.

sites.name: Sam's Club Distribution Center New Braunfels TX

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The supplied coordinates (29.734335, -98.064532) landed directly on the
building. Satellite at z16/z15 showed a single very large industrial
distribution building on the SE side of I-35, with cross-dock loading on both
long faces and extensive trailer drop yards, unmistakably a big-box regional
DC, not an office. Web search corroborated the address (4002 I-35 N) and the
operation: TruckMap/TruckerPath list it as "Walmart/Sam's Club Distribution
Center," appointment-required deliveries, ~40-minute load times. Street View at
the N entrance shows a "WAL-MART Distribution Services" sign on the building
wall, confirming this is the Walmart-operated Sam's Club DC. Locked center at
29.73430, -98.06410.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded truck checkpoint at the N corner off the I-35 frontage road; Street View (pano 6YhsOK6P85aaVVAVb_aohg, 2018-12, heading ~230) shows striped truck lanes with painted STOP, channelizing bollards, and gate infrastructure across the lanes against the WAL-MART Distribution Services building wall.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small single-footprint metal guard booth with side windows and a covered canopy walkway sits beside the inbound lane at the gate; clearly visible in Street View heading 290 and 230.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approx 2 inbound lanes at the checkpoint apron; exact lane split partly obscured by sun glare in the 2018 pano - estimate.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Approx 2 outbound lanes; combined gate so in/out share the same checkpoint apron.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron inside the gate between the booth and the building before trucks fan out to docks/yard - room to queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron with multiple striped lanes and unused paved width - physical room to add an express/appointment bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building with continuous dock-door rhythm and trailers backed in along both long faces (SW and NE) plus the secondary building - well into the 50+ band, est ~180 doors total.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Enormous trailer drop/storage operation: dozens of long rows of parked drop trailers fill the SW and SE yards - hundreds of stalls, 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks run from two distinct building faces (SW long face and NE long face) on the main cross-dock, consistent with separate ship/receive clusters - inferred from overhead.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a separate secondary building (maintenance/transportation) to the SE on the same property.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main distribution building plus a separate building cluster to the SE sharing the same fenced yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial site on the I-35 corridor NE of New Braunfels with open farmland on the E and S; judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is not connected to the site.
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale/weigh pad identified in the truck path; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Estimate from z17-z19 imagery across SW and SE yards - approximate count of parked trailers in the captured frames.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Honest overhead estimate across both faces of the cross-dock plus the secondary building.

The supplied coordinates (31.265479, -89.268464) landed inside the J M Tatum

Satellite z18–z20 at the confirmed point shows a **long cross-dock building
(~137 m, long axis ~ESE) with dock doors on BOTH long faces and trailers backed

business listings is the registration/office footprint, not the operating

sites.name: Sam's Club Distribution Center Oklahoma City OK

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The supplied ROOFTOP coordinates (35.440812, -97.650807) landed directly on a
large white-roof distribution building on the east side of S Council Rd. Web
research confirmed this is Oklahoma's first Sam's Club distribution center
(~300,000 sq ft dry-goods DC, ~130 employees, ~$40M investment, ribbon-cut
Jan 2024). Positive ID came from 2025-05 Street View at the north entrance off
S Council Rd, which clearly shows a **"Sam's Club Distribution Center" monument
sign with the Sam's Club logo** at the main entrance drive. This is the correct
building, not an office or unrelated property.

The given coordinates were accurate; I set the audit center to the geometric
centroid of the fenced property (35.439775, -97.651625).

---

fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is enclosed by a black metal perimeter fence along the S Council Rd frontage and around the truck/dock yard (clearly visible in 2025-05 Street View). Trucks pass through a controlled fence opening off the main entrance drive; classified as a truck gate. No barrier arm is visible across the public-road throat itself, but the secured fence line with vehicle gates is the access control.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the entrance in 2025-05 Street View or 2026 satellite. The main entry is an open paved approach with the Sam's Club monument sign; access control is the fence/sliding gate at the yard, implying kiosk/app/badge check-in rather than a manned shack. fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court between the building dock faces and the drop yard provides interior holding room; inferred.

fieldNotes.exitLanes: Shared single outbound lane at the same entrance; estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and generous paved entrance with room to stripe an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two large cross-dock buildings, each with a long continuous bank of dock doors (east face of north building plus west/east faces of south building). Total well above 50; counted ~80-100 across the complex.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer drop yard east of the buildings with multiple long rows of parked trailers; capacity 100+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks appear on opposing faces of the complex (east-facing dock on north building, west-facing Werner dock on south building) but cannot confirm a formal ship/receive split; left false.

sites.name: Sam's Club Distribution Center Jacksonville FL

steps.step: Arrive at gate, queue for guard

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The supplied coordinates (30.419193, -81.622538) landed on **undeveloped
woodland** about 800 m south of the actual facility, the satellite imagery at
that point is pre-construction pine plantation. The real building is north of
there.

Web research fixed it: this is Building E / "Building 300" in **Imeson
Park South**, a VanTrust logistics park in North Jacksonville. The 1
million-square-foot, $61M Sam's Club DC opened April 2025 (fully
operational since February 2025), sits on a ~23-acre footprint, and is staffed
by ~250 workers (Jax Daily Record, JAXUSA, Supply Chain Dive, Progressive
Grocer).

Disambiguation mattered here because the park has several large boxes:
Building 100 = Sub-Zero (~203k sf), Building 200 = Primark (~547k sf),
Building 300 / E = Sam's Club (1M sf), plus an Amazon-branded building

fieldNotes.siteConfirmation: Building E / Building 300 at 1511 Zoo Pkwy, Imeson Park South. Supplied coords (30.4192,-81.6225) landed on undeveloped woodland south of the park (pre-construction imagery); the real 1M-sqft Sam's Club DC building center is ~30.4247,-81.6235. Confirmed via Jax Daily Record / JAXUSA grand-opening coverage (opened Apr 2025, $61M, 1M sqft, ~23-acre footprint, fully operational Feb 2025) and by tracing the gate drive off the road named 'Sam's Club Range Blvd' to the largest building in the park; distinguished from the adjacent Amazon-branded building immediately to the west and from Primark (Bldg 200) and Sub-Zero (Bldg 100).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded truck checkpoint on the SE entrance drive off Sam's Club Range Blvd. 2023-01 and 2025-02 Street View both show gate arms across the truck lanes, a 'DO NOT BLOCK' painted apron, a STOP sign, and tractors/trailers (black tractor + XTRA trailer) queued at the gate. Satellite z19/z20 shows the booth island and lane striping.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small modular guard booth (~1-2-vehicle footprint, windows, set on the median between the in/out truck lanes) is clearly visible at the gate in Street View and overhead at z20.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single guarded gate point on the SE drive handles both inbound and outbound trucks (booth island splits the lanes).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Read ~2 inbound lanes split by the gate-island booth; not perfectly resolved at ground level, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated ~2 outbound lanes opposite the booth; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane paved gate apron with the booth on a center island and unused paved width; room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding/staging area inside the gate at the SE corner before trucks proceed to the east dock bank along the canal.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep approach: the truck drive runs a long way from the public road through the gate and around to the dock yards; ample room to stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 1M-sqft cross-dock. East face along the retention canal carries a continuous bank of ~30-35 dock positions (most with trailers backed in, counted across two z19 frames); west face carries an additional dock bank facing the shared central truck corridor. Total estimated ~85 doors -> band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer-parking rows in the central truck corridor between the Sam's building and the Amazon building (labeled bays full of parked trailers), plus drop trailers backed at the east dock wall; 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Yes - dedicated trailer-storage rows in the central corridor, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks run from two physically separate banks on different building faces (east-along-canal and west); corroborated by reporting that the DC is split into an import side (feeds other warehouses) and a direct-to-club retail side.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: North Jacksonville metro: dense VanTrust logistics park (Imeson Park South, ~3.3M sqft across 7 buildings) just off I-95/I-295, minutes from Jacksonville International Airport and Blount Island port. Major-metro industrial fabric -> Urban.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Urban metro location with strong carrier coverage; false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single Sam's Club building (Building E/300). The neighboring Amazon, Primark, and Sub-Zero buildings are separate parcels/tenants in the same park, not part of this property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh platform positively identified in the truck path; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the park is not rail-served.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~62 acres via shoelace on the traced fence-line perimeter (building + employee parking + east canal-side dock yard + central drop corridor). The building footprint alone is ~23 acres per press coverage.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count (~80) across the captured z16-z19 imagery: east dock wall ~30-35, central drop corridor ~25-35, west dock apron ~15.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Rough estimate (~160) of drop/parking capacity across the central corridor and dock aprons; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Property line traced inside the fence: west edge follows the centerline of the drop-yard corridor shared with the Amazon building; east edge runs just beyond the dock wall along the retention canal; the SE wastewater-treatment plant is excluded.
fieldNotes.imageryNote: Most overhead imagery is recent (building complete). The clearest gate Street View is 2023-01 (gate already built, trucks queued); 2025-02 Street View confirms the completed checkpoint. The DC opened Apr 2025 / operational Feb 2025.

sites.name: Sam's Club Distribution Center Edwardsville IL
sites.dossierExcerpt:
The supplied coords (38.766772, -90.051418) landed on the NW corner of the
correct building. Web research confirms a ~370,000 sq ft Sam's Club
distribution / fulfillment center at 5710 Inner Park Dr in Exeter Inner Park,
Edwardsville, opened January 2024 (Walmart corporate, Supply Chain Dive, St.
Louis Regional Freightway, CoStar). The site is the large white-roofed building
in the center of the park, distinct from the brown/dark-roofed warehouses to
the N and the trailer-heavy warehouse across the west canal (a different
tenant). Locked center 38.7659, -90.0513; building long axis runs N–S, rotated
~3° clockwise.

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or controlled checkpoint visible at any entrance in current (c2026) satellite imagery. Access from Inner Park Drive is an open driveway over a landscaped causeway between two stormwater ponds. Site is bounded by canals/ponds (natural barriers) on W and E rather than a security fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No 1-3-car guard booth at the truck entrance. The only small structure on site is an elongated dark-roofed utility/maintenance building (~30m) set inside the NW parking lot near a pond, not at a gate pinch-point.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all (not because of a kiosk).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Vast empty paved aprons (east yard and south apron) inside the property provide ample queue/holding space before docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock canopy with regular door rhythm across the full south (short) face, ~175m wide; estimated ~44 doors from overhead imagery -> 25-50 band. Low-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked drop-trailer stalls observed; the east and south aprons are open undelineated concrete. Essentially no trailers parked in the c2026 imagery (lightly utilized, opened Jan 2024).
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated striped trailer-storage lot; large empty aprons could function as drop space but are not configured/used as one.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate of what the open east+south aprons could hold if striped; the lot is not currently marked for trailers.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park (Exeter Inner Park, Edwardsville) surrounded by farmland and new-build warehouses; greater St. Louis metro fringe -> Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and oversized paved yards give abundant room to add express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Entry driveway is a wide two-lane causeway with a center median; in/out share the same point.
fieldNotes.streetView: Only Aug 2023 Street View coverage exists (pano HynqAHaV96KQ1s-UvAkkJg), captured during construction before the building was completed/occupied; it shows the Exeter Inner Park monument and graded earth, not the finished gate. Gate/guard-shack calls therefore rest on current satellite, hence medium confidence.

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The supplied coordinates (44.79338, -93.423903) landed on the NE corner of the
correct property. Web research confirms a Sam's Club multipurpose DC, ~365,000
sq ft, in Shakopee's new Southwest Logistics Center near Hwy 169/101, that
opened in March 2024. Satellite at zoom 16-18 shows a single large
rectangular distribution building with truck aprons and dock doors on its north
and south faces, employee/visitor parking and an office on the east, a roundabout
on Hentges Way to the east, and a multi-track rail yard along the south boundary.
This matches a Sam's Club DC, not an office or unrelated property. The building
long axis runs WSW-ENE, rotated roughly 8° counter-clockwise from east-west, so
every geofence zone is traced as a rotated quad rather than a north-aligned box.
Locked center: 44.79255, -93.42620.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck lane at the NE corner off Hentges Way; chevron/crosshatch gore markings at the entry throat and two tractor-trailers queued in-lane in current satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small standalone white booth (~1-2 stall footprint) set beside the truck entry lane at the NE pinch point, distinct from the main office building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court inside the gate before the dock aprons gives deep internal queuing room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Perimeter truck drive from the NE gate to the docks holds well more than 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and generous paved truck-court width leave room for a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on both the north and south building faces; north face alone shows 25-30 doors with trailers plus continuation off-frame, total clearly 50+. Count of 110 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer staging row along the north apron plus loaded south apron; 50+ staged/parked trailers across the site.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters on opposite (north and south) building faces.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Southwest Logistics Center, Shakopee MN, surrounded by farmland, rail yard, ponds and aggregate lots, not dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A multi-track rail yard runs along the south boundary but is separated from the building by a vegetated buffer; no spur enters the docks. DC is truck-served.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad positively identified in the truck path; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Entry and exit share the single NE gate lane group; exit lane count inferred as 1.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter polygon (~33-34 acres of fenced paved property); overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Only road-level coverage is a 2022-04 pano on Hentges Way at the roundabout, captured before the building was built (opened March 2024), so it shows empty land; gate/guard determinations rely on current high-res satellite, not Street View.

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The supplied coordinates (33.760294, -84.610591) landed on the south parking/lawn
of the correct building. Confirmed via:
- Web research: Sam's Club fully leased Prologis' 1.1M-sqft spec warehouse in
  RiverWest, Lithia Springs ($142M, 600 jobs, occupied ~June 2024). The large
  single building at the center of the imagery matches a 1.1M-sqft footprint
  (~1000 ft x 1100 ft).
- Ground truth: The 2025-03 Street View monument sign at the entrance reads
  "PROLOGIS / sams club / Associate-Visitor / Truck", positive ID.
The building runs roughly N-S, rotated ~5° clockwise (north end shifts east).

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entry at SW corner where private drive meets public road: pinch point with lane/stop-bar markings, perimeter chain-link fence, and a Prologis/Sam's Club monument sign listing separate 'Associate/Visitor' and 'Truck' lanes (confirmed in 2025-03 Street View).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white ~1-vehicle-footprint booth set beside the entry lane at the SW gate, visible in z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: continuous dock-door banks with trailers backed in along BOTH long faces (east and west), implying physically separate receive/ship clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band; counted continuous dock rhythm down both ~1000ft long faces. 180 is an order-of-magnitude estimate for a 1.1M sqft cross-dock, not an exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked across both wide truck courts (east and west); banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and already-split associate/truck lanes at the entrance leave room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound from lane markings at the gate apron; low confidence from overhead.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense metro-Atlanta industrial fabric (RiverWest / Prologis park, Lithia Springs), surrounded by other large DCs.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate from combined east+west truck-court paved area; approximate.
